card.name: Small words in step-by-step instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words and determiners such as in, new, an, one, additional, or, on inside procedural instructions or technical descriptions. They sit just before a thing being added, created or placed.

modes.label: Add or create steps
modes.description: Determiners or numbers right after verbs like add or create, before the object being added.
modes.example: 1. Add<< one>> tablespoon of applesauce to an empty bowl

modes.label: Additional items
modes.description: The word additional or a linking word before extra items in technical lists.
modes.example: Additional PCI bus bridges 222 and 224 provide interfaces for<< additional>> PCI buses 226 and

modes.label: Reference linking words
modes.description: Prepositions after a numbered or labelled item, pointing to where it goes.
modes.example: Measure the radioactivity and record as item (1)<< on>> the Technetium Tc 9

card.writes: The promoted words (transition, junction) hint at a small push toward words about change or joining, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in how-to steps, just before the next object or action is named.
